pr_body:
MulticastOption.Group is not supposed to accept null. If someone sets it to null, we will NRE inside of the Sockets implementation.

I also fixed two small double-cast problems while I was in here.

Fix #32490

Note that this is a breaking change. I'm not sure all the ways I'm supposed to document this. If anyone has thoughts, please let me know.

issue_context.title: MulticastOption Group setter should not allow null
issue_context.body:
`MulticastOption`'s constructor doesn't allow the `IPAddress group` parameter to be `null`.

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/5ee7f889f722c0086c5bebdab5d854e0efbf0c79/src/libraries/System.Net.Sockets/src/System/Net/Sockets/MulticastOption.cs#L14-L59

However, the public property for `Group` allows it to be set to `null`:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/5ee7f889f722c0086c5bebdab5d854e0efbf0c79/src/libraries/System.Net.Sockets/src/System/Net/Sockets/MulticastOption.cs#L61-L72

This is inconsistent. And when trying to add nullable annotations to this class, this setter forces the getter to allow returning `null`. Which means all consuming code will need to check for `null`, when it really isn't an acceptable state for this class to be in.

The IPv6 version of this class fixes this issue by throwing an `ArgumentNullException` in the setter:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/5ee7f889f722c0086c5bebdab5d854e0efbf0c79/src/libraries/System.Net.Sockets/src/System/Net/Sockets/MulticastOption.cs#L144-L160

We should consider a small breaking change here and throw an `ArgumentNullException` from `MulticastOption.Group`'s setter.

/cc @stephentoub @davidsh @dotnet/ncl 

NOTE: If we don't change the setter to reject `null`, we will need to decide what to do when it is `null`. Currently, we NRE:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8291187/74755233-7999f300-5238-11ea-8274-a8b261c57ee4.png)
